_about: Manual audit of every failed Ease run in v2-fixture and v2-cmp-ease, one entry per run, classified from the stored answer and the run's step log (data/eval/<run>.log). Causes: detail_only = the filter field (posting date) is shown only on each job's detail page, not on the listing; early_end = the extraction step ended before every page was read; wrong_value = a single value read from the wrong item. 'how' says which form early_end took. Audited by the first author; not blind.

causes.detail_only: filter field only on detail pages
causes.early_end: extraction ended before every page was read
causes.wrong_value: value read from the wrong item
